note: Secret NAMES the production Worker needs, never values. A new version of this Worker copies its secrets from the NEWEST uploaded version, not from the deployed one, and branch builds upload versions here. Run `npm run check:release` before and after every production release. test/release-secrets.test.js keeps this list in step with src/.

required.RESEND_API_KEY: every email (MAIL_TRANSPORT=resend, src/mail-transport.js), the newsletter Segment and Topic (src/newsletter.js, src/unsubscribe.js) and beta feature access (src/feature-access.js). One Resend key per Worker, named after the Worker, saved in 1Password
required.NEWSLETTER_LINK_SECRET: signs the /unsubscribe links in list mail (src/unsubscribe.js). Its own random secret, never the Resend key, so rotating the key never breaks a link already sent
required.RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET: verifies Resend's signed delivery events at /api/resend-events (src/resend-events.js); the whsec_ value from the Resend webhook
required.GMAIL_CLIENT_ID: fallback mail through Gmail if MAIL_TRANSPORT is set back to gmail (src/mail-transport.js); remove with the Gmail transport

do_not_set.BETA_AUTH_SIGNING_KEY: Faisal, Nov 11: beta testers do not get their own signing key. Leave it unset so src/beta-access.js signs beta sessions with ADMIN_AUTH_SIGNING_KEY.

retired.AIRTABLE_TOKEN: no longer read anywhere in src/
retired.BEEHIIV_API_KEY: no longer read anywhere in src/ (newsletters moved to Resend)
